mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, a.author_id AS authorId, u1.nickname AS authorName, a.status, a.audit_opinion AS auditOpinion, a.auditor_id AS auditorId, u2.nickname AS auditorName, a.publish_time AS publishTime, a.create_time AS createTime, a.update_time AS updateTime, a.view_count AS viewCount, a.version
FROM cms_article a LEFT JOIN cms_category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON u1.id = a.author_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON u2.id = a.auditor_id WHERE a.deleted = 0
